summary: Frontend-only F3 validation completed for @cutsync/business via build checks, static contract regression, and preview smoke. Typecheck, lint, and Expo web export passed. F3 agenda/timeline/block/walk-in contracts are present and static tests passed (8/8). Full authenticated runtime F3 flow remains blocked in preview by missing public Supabase runtime config.

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated Agenda F3 runtime flow (week strip, timeline interactions, own/team, block rendering, empty-slot to walk-in)
integration_issues.issue: Could not execute authenticated E2E runtime verification in preview because sign-in is in environment-not-configured state ('Este ambiente ainda não está configurado.').

action_items: Configure preview runtime with EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, then rerun authenticated F3 E2E validations.
After env enablement, validate real interactions for: slot permission gating by capability/accessMode, own/team block RPC scopes, and empty-slot prefill into walk-in using real data.
critical_code_review_comments: F3 core contracts are implemented in reviewed files: Monday week-start, local-date shifting, 7-day strip with occupancy from real agenda queries, timeline/list toggle with accessible state, timeline 07:00-21:00 in 30-min slots, now-line only for today, own/team column rendering, cancelled/no-show segregation, and slot->walk-in parameter navigation.

Schedule block query and overlap behavior are contract-aligned by code + SQL inspection: get_business_schedule_blocks called via RPC with local day boundaries, own/team professional filtering, and overlap predicates (starts_at < range_end and ends_at > range_start) supporting cross-midnight/day-spanning blocks.
No MOCKED API usage detected in reviewed F3 flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed and passed: yarn --ignore-engines typecheck:business, yarn --ignore-engines lint:business, yarn --ignore-engines workspace @cutsync/business expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-business-f3-verify. Added static regression file /app/tests/test_business_agenda_f3_static.py (8 tests, all passing). Preview smoke at /sign-in succeeds but remains blocked for authenticated runtime due missing public Supabase env.
rca of the issue: Primary blocker is environment configuration, not F3 feature code regression. Preview auth gate reports unconfigured runtime, preventing login and therefore runtime verification of Agenda F3 interactions with real user session/state. Mitigation: provide EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL + EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in preview and rerun E2E F3 scenarios.
